notes.title: Patch Notes v1.28
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone,

We have made improvements regarding the discomfort users experienced.
All changes will be available in the game after the update.[/b]


[h3][b][Balance Modification][/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] Decreased the HP of Normal, Elite monsters from chapter 5, 6, 7, 8 by 15%.
[*] Deleted the penalty of Monster’s HP increase, caused by the Danger Level.
[*] Deleted [Normal monster HP increase], [Elite monster HP increase], [Boss monster HP increase] among Danger Level Penalties.

[b] ** Developer's Comment[/b]
 - There was a lot of feedback saying as players progressed through the chapters, monster’s HP increased too steeply. By this patch we are deleting many penalties related to monster’s HP increase in order to reduce fatigue of the game.

[*] Deleted [Solo Core] and [Solo Gear] among the Danger Level Traits.
[*] Revised the effect of [Broken Gear] among the Danger Level Traits.
[list]
[*] Before) When possessing [Broken Gear], with a 50% chance, all 3 will be Broken Gear at the Gear Box.
[*] After) When possessing [Broken Gear], with a 50% chance, only 1 of 3 will be Broken Gear at the Gear Box.
[/list]
[b] ** Developer's Comment[/b]
 - We want to delete or revise unnecessary penalties that disturb character’s growth.

[*] Revised the exchange ratio between Red Gem and Rose.
[list]
[*] Before) Red Gem 300 →  Rose 10
[*] After) Red Gem 300 → Rose 20
[/list]
[*] Revised IndiJones’s renewal price.
 - Players can renew for free up to 3 times and for the fourth time, 50 Rose is required. The renewal price increases by 150% compared to the previous price. (Before: 200%)
The price of Dice is initialized when entering a new chapter.

[b] ** Developer's Comment[/b]
 - Rose is an important item and is difficult to obtain. We plan to increase the amount of Rose players can earn or lessen the amount of Rose players need to consume.

[*] Renewal function of Character Traits [Core Type Changer], [Deception], [Jack in the Box] is recharged after clearing a chapter. When the possible renewal number is recharged, the trait icon appears for a while.

[b] ** Developer's Comment[/b]
 - There was a problem of players not able to use [Core Type Changer], [Deception], [Jack in the Box] willingly due to limited renewal number. From now on, after players clears a chapter these traits are recharged.

[*] Fixed a bug where the Danger Level Penalty was not applied on boss monsters.
[list]
[*] When a boss monster’s HP drops below 50%, it is immune to damage for 5 sec.
[*] Boss monsters recover 1.5% of maximum HP every 15 sec when the HP is below 50%.
[*] Boss ATK is increased by 10%~30%.
[*] Boss ATK increases 5% for every 20 sec. (Maximum ATK increase: 150%)
[/list]
[b]** Developer's Comment[/b]
 - There were feedbacks saying that Boss monsters were easier to clear than Normal/Elite monsters. To analyze this situation we checked systems related to boss monsters and found out that Danger Level Penalty was not being applied on boss monsters. With this patch, users will face boss monsters which have Danger Level Penalty applied.
[/olist]

We expect players will be able to enjoy the game more after this improvement patch. We will continuously listen to users’ feedback and give better experience to users playing Blade Assault.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!
We’re back with the Patch Notes for the April update.

After the 1.2 update, you’ll be able to meet our new character Zett and experience the drone system.
Please find the details below.

Starting from April 29th, we’ll also be discounting Blade Assault for 40% to celebrate the update, so for those who do not own Blade Assault yet, this is the best timing!

[previewyoutube=f36xpoP8v-0;full][/previewyoutube]

[u]"If you need my help."[/u]

‘Zett’, who’s been showing its back this whole time, is finally on the move!
He is not afraid of jumping into the swarm of enemies. Recharge the shield by striking your enemies and activate it by using skill.

Once the friendship level is high enough, players can change their character to Zett by talking to him. Try out Zett’s cybernetic arm and its 9 new upgrades!


[h3][b][Hailey’s Drone][/b][/h3]
- 6 new drones are added along with Hailey’s drone upgrade system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/70a79c6c9d702e39816850ee2877d7c0e81c81d4.png[/img]
[u]"Drone, our best mate!"[/u]

Players can increase Hailey’s friendship level from Armstrong at the jazz bar, and can change the drone by using Chips from Hailey at the armory.
[list]
[*] Friendship Level 1 : One drone is available from Hailey. Rare drone appears.
[*] Friendship Level 2 : Two drones are available from Hailey. Epic drones appear.
[*] Friendship Level 3 : Three drones are available from Hailey. Legendary drones appear.
[/list]- You may only buy one from 3 drones.
- Purchased drones can be found in the gear inventory.
- Changes to default drone(Bit) if the character dies and wakes up in Hank’s Room
- Changes to default drone(Bit) if the character clears the game and wakes up in the jazz bar.

[b][Drone Types][/b]
[list]
[*] Red Drone : Drops 300 Roses when the player starts the game by taking the armory’s port.
[*] Energy Drone : Player character recovers 50 MP when using an active gear.
[*] Box Drone : Destructible objects have a 5% chance of dropping HP healing food.
[*] Medic Drone : Player character recovers10 HP every 60 seconds.
[*] Machine Gun Drone : Hits the enemy 30 times every 5 seconds for 3 seconds. Deals 10% of player character’s Normal ATK. Drone’s DMG increases as the player’s Normal ATK increases. 
[/list]
[h3][b][Randolph’s Potions][/b][/h3]
- 'Randolph' is added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/d19fd65401bb2ed9cd2635e1651f0ba6cb129794.png[/img]
[u]"What are you hesitating for? Just drink it off."[/u]

[list]
[*] Friendship Level 1 : One potion is available from Randolph. Normal potion appears.
[*] Friendship Level 2 : Two potions are available from Randolph. Rare potions appear. 
[*] Friendship Level 3 : Three potions are available from Randolph. Epic potions appear. [/list]- You may only buy one from 3 potions.

- One of these three NPCs, IndiJones / Jean / Jack, will randomly appear in Hotel Halona.

[b]1. Jack’s Gambit[/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/cc506e159b203d77fd257eac4674c42e14d558eb.png[/img]
[u]"I always have something up my sleeve."[/u]

[*] Fixed normal ATK
[*] Fixed skill ATK
[*] Fixed sub weapon ATK

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/b212b08f78b3d4cd0cada15a3488520bfe30597a.png[/img]
[u]"Better for everyone to find their place."[/u]

[*] [Elite Instructor]: Enemies on the field will appear as elites.

[*] [Sub Weapon Double Cooldown]: Player’s sub weapon cooldown time will double.

- Maximum stats are now shown in the info screen.

[h3][b][Effect][/b][/h3]
- Executioner elites will glow in red.



[b]We appreciate your continuous support and feedback. Please keep supporting us!

Thank you.[/b]

notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve been focusing on development and going through your feedback since the official release.

Thank you for enjoying our game.

Today, we’d like to briefly inform you about an upcoming update in April.

This April’s update will bring you 3 new pieces of content.

notes.title: Dev Note #4
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

We have been closely reviewing all of the feedback sent to us since official release.
Among the feedback, we think that the following are the two major issues.
[h3][list]
[*] Combat fatigue due to a single long gameplay session
[*] Combat becomes boring due to the high HP of bosses and enemies
[/list][/h3]
Both issues can be resolved simply by reducing stages and lowering HP. However we would like to address more fundamental causes instead.

When failing a challenge in a roguelike game, players should be able to imagine the build for the next challenge and actually create the build envisioned within the game. A system that allows players to address unexpected situations resulting at random is also needed.

We are aware that such experiences are not fully provided with the current Blade Assault systems. As such, we’ll continue to improve and add systems to create an even more enjoyable game. 
[h3][olist]
[*] Increase default stats for weapons of all characters
[*] Increase the amount of Red Gems and Roses dropped by enemies
[*] Improve so that certain cores can be leveled up as much as wanted on the Nautilus 
[*] Add restock system for the gear vending machine (uses Coins)
[*] Add new Legendary gears and cores
[*] Reduce Threat level debuff values
[*] Add new camps like Hotel Halona for each stage
[/olist][/h3][list]
[*] New NPCs will appear at the camps
[*] Experience diverse progression and equipment through NPC features
[/list]
[h3][b][Add IndiJones Dice Selection][/b][/h3]
ㅇ Fee Change: Roses → Coin (Doubles each time it is restocked)

[*] Buff (Debuff) obtain or lose 1-1000 Red Gems

[/list]However currency will not fall below 0

[/list]
[h3][b][Randolph][/b][/h3]
ㅇReceive specific buff when quest accepted

[*] Quest will have difficulty levels, with the higher the difficulty, the better the reward.
[/list][b]▶ Rewards - Legendary Core / Legendary Gear / Red Gems / Roses[/b]

[h3][b][Jean][/b][/h3]
ㅇ Fee: Coin (Doubles each time it is restocked)

notes.title: Blade Assault Official Release
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This is Team Suneat.

We're happy to announce that [b]Blade Assault[/b] is finally ready for its full release!
To celebrate, we're running a special discount for a limited time starting from the day of the release, so be sure to share the news with your friends!

[previewyoutube=uV-fWC5zbfw;full][/previewyoutube]

With the 1.0 release, new chapters and a brand new core system will be added.

[*] The final ending to the game is now available

This is a huge update and one giant step forward for the team, but our adventure is far from over. Even after the 1.0 release, we're going to continue adding content for our players to enjoy.

[h3]New Characters[/h3]
Our next playable character in line, Jett, was scheduled to appear in the last quarter of 2021. notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4
notes.content:
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now see skill descriptions by hovering your mouse over the skill’s icon.
[*] The number of waves during port battles decreased.
[*] The cost of Rio’s hacking service decreased to 200.
[*] Sophia’s risk gear cost increased by 300.
[*] Elite enemies’ Gem/Rose drop rate increased by 50%.
[*] The assault level no longer causes the risk level to increase.
[*] Rio doesn’t appear at Hotel Halona.
[/list]
 
[h3]Risk Level[/h3]
[list]
[*]Risk level no longer increases during regular and boss battles.
[*]Risk level accumulates quickly only when the port is active. 
[*]Each time the risk level increases by 1, players will receive one of the following debuffs.
  - The normal enemies’ DMG increases by 20%~60%.
  - The maximum HP of the normal enemies increases by 20%~60%.
  - Elite's DMG increases by 20%~60%.
  - Elite's maximum HP increases by 20%~60%.
  - Boss' DMG increases by 20%~60%.
  - Boss's maximum HP increases by 20%~60%.
  - If the boss's HP falls below 50%, it will be invincible for 10 seconds once.
  - If the boss’s HP falls below 50%, 3% of its maximum HP recovers every 10 seconds.

notes.title: Dev Note #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

It has been a while since the last dev letter. We are reading every feedback from all the players. They have been a huge help to the development process, and we’re working hard to polish the game before the official release. 

Right now, we are working on Chapter 5, the next chapter of the Plantos lab. Chapter 5 includes stages that lead up to the giant lift, the very last step to Esperanza. More powerful enemies will emerge, and players will encounter the guardian of Esperanza, the gigantic robot ‘Cyclops’ for the boss battle.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/8c8c2631ca6d0c3e076bce1fa7a22acb1cd37bac.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/e05228c827415b96a2b5d4b76ee3b1eba2c84d3e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/1c74a72eab786135ea73ccca29149b801842bb04.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/eb25d0aa9c72bd2e795a0fd5d32bf65f49dbaa7f.png[/img]



[b]We are also reforming the core system of the game: the risk level and related contents. [/b]


[b]1. The risk level increase system will be reformed due to the imbalance.[/b]
: The risk level only increases when the player activates the port or during the boss battle.
: The risk level will not rapidly increase with the normal battles.
: The risk level can be altered during the normal battle with the player’s choice.

[b]There will be 3 more map objects that will provide rewards in return for increased risk levels.[/b]
2-1) Dangerous Gearbox
: The risk level increases by 1 when you open the Gearbox, in the chance of 60%
: The chance of legendary gear is high for the Gearbox.
: New legendary gears are added.

2-2) Healing Pack
: The risk level increases by 1 when you activate the healing pack in the chance of 60%
: Random HP increase by 60~120

2-3) Max Delivery
: Max from hotel Halona delivers food for you.
: When you call Max, the risk level increases by 1 in the chance of 60%
: You will obtain random food from ★2 ~ ★4



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/7dd52b2ad3dd0bf20c9cba20c4e9aec16a03c959.gif[/img]


[b]Monster reinforcement according to the risk level[/b]
The existing system increased the abilities of the elite monsters according to the level of risk and to appear with one of the skills they can acquire at random. 

Now, whenever the risk level rises, the reinforcement factor of monsters is set at random. Reinforcement factors according to the risk level can be found in the UI.


[b][Enemy buff list as the danger level goes up (subject to updates)][/b]
- The normal enemies’ DMG increases by 20% ~ 40%.
- The maximum HP of the normal enemies increases by 20% ~ 40%.
- Elite's DMG increases by 20% ~ 40%.
- Elite's maximum HP increases by 20% ~ 40%.
- Boss' DMG increases by 20% ~ 40%.
- Boss's maximum HP increases by 20% to 40%.
- If the boss's HP falls below 50%, he will be invincible for 10 seconds once.
- Restores 5% of the maximum HP every second from less than 50% of the boss' HP.
- The boss' DMG increases by 10% every 10 seconds after his appearance. (Maximum DMG: 300%)
- [Resurrection] Elite will appear. When the elite's HP reaches zero, it recovers to its maximum HP once with a 50% chance.
- [Trace of Poison] Elite will appear. Creates poisonous smoke in the path. Players in the smoke get poisoned
- [Corpse explosion] Elite will appear. When the elite's HP reaches zero, it explodes a while later and damages the area.
- [Minefield] Elite will appear. When the elite's HP reaches zero, three bombs are thrown.
- [Echo of the Coldness] Elite will appear. When the elite's HP reaches zero, a cold air explosion occurs and freezes the player in the area.
- [Executor] Elite will appear. Every time another elite around the elite dies, they gain 20% of DMG and HP.
- [Energy Combustion] Elite will appear. As you get closer to the elite, you lose 20 energy every second.
- [Death Resistance] Elite will appear. When the elite's HP reaches zero, it gets revived and moves for a certain period of time.

※ [Death Resistance] Elite was a deleted ability because it was unreasonable to attack the player without being damaged when its HP reaches zero. If an elite with this ability appears, it will be modified to be affected by abnormal conditions such as rigidity, stun, and inactivity buffs, so the players won’t have to run away as they did before.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/11a12c716b785c3667e38d8274ca7c11331706b0.png[/img]


The risk level system was in the game as a device that gives tension to the game and forces faster choices, but the feedback players have sent made us realize that it did not function in the direction we wanted. 

The updated risk-level system eliminates existing shortcomings and ensures strong compensation for overcoming them, creating a sense of challenge. We will make sure that the element of luck can be applied in this process according to the genre of rogue-lite. This is to ensure that the risk level and related content can proceed in a different way in every play without getting bored.

Please look forward to Blade Assault, which will get better and better. 
All mentioned contents will be updated sequentially. Please look forward to it.

[i]※The information above is subject to change and modification during the development process.[/i]

Hello, this is Team Suneat.

It’s already been 2 weeks since we launched the game in Early Access.
During Early Access, we will constantly communicate with this community and shape the game together to create the best version of it that we possibly can. 
We have been receiving great feedback and your voice will be considered seriously in our development process.

To all those who play our game, we sincerely thank you and now, this is our upcoming development plan.

[olist]

[*] Improvements in progressing the stage

[list]
[*] We’ve decided to change the current stage system after monitoring the gameplay and going through a lot of feedback since the launch. We strongly agree, especially in this kind of genre, that there must be a different and exciting new experience for players that makes the game replayable. Keeping this in mind, we are planning to add some new systems.

[*] Improvement in Risk Level
Currently the Risk Level increases over time, but we are planning to change this. Only when the port is operating and by the player’s choice of action will it increase the Risk Level. For instance, when opening a gear box you can choose to not spend the gems but instead increase the Risk Level by chance of 50%.

[*] Randomness
We are working on stages with different level designs and new objects. Our plan is to allow players to have various experiences in every map while playing the game multiple times.

[*] Playtime
There were many comments regarding the excessive wave repetition and long play time that resulted in player’s frustration. Thus, we are considering many ways such as to cut the number of wave repetitions and reduce the size of the map, to improve the player’s playing experience.

notes.title: Launch Date & FGT Schedule
notes.content:
Hello gamers! 

We’re here with an update to show you guys what we’ve been working on.

[h3]Regarding Early-Access[/h3]
We’ve originally planned for our game’s Early Access to start on March 2021. But truth be told, we don’t think that this is feasible due to COVID-19 making it difficult for us to work together. We’ve also decided to be a bit more greedy and add more contents from the very start of Early-Access.


We also want to tell you guys that we have read every single one of your feedback and comments about the game and are hard at work to implement changes that are needed. Early-Access isn’t something that we consider lightly and we want to make absolutely sure that the game meets the quality that you gamers are expecting. Ultimately, we’ve decided to postpone our Early-Access launch to June, we hope that we’ll be able to deliver the gaming experience we want for you all to enjoy.

So what’s changing? We’re focusing on the game’s ‘combat system’ and ‘permanent upgrades.’

[h3]Improvements to Combat[/h3]
Our game’s three main pillars of combat are ‘Weapon Upgrades,’ ‘Gears,’ and ‘Cores.’ 
In the demo we’ve released, users only really got to utilize Cores, which can be tedious and stale and isn’t the full gameplay experience we wanted to deliver. We’re making overall improvements and completing ‘Weapon Upgrades’ & ‘Gears’ so that progress for each run feels more exciting.  

[list]
[*] Weapon Upgrades
Meet Honk during your runs and trade in ‘Roses’ to get powerful upgrades for your equipped weapon of choice. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/fd334e4366f11362dcff3732420bccd35c213aed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/e54d2dddc4dfe8cafcc2ae948032f304acdf1cfa.png[/img]

Weapon upgrades are extremely powerful and versatile. Each type of upgrade has upto 5 levels, the amount of ‘Roses’ needed to upgrade greatly increases per level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/1e34be4f40b8c2ea7ab6e633bc2228f55c510fa1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/d137c3e7d8b8350078356b9d4a3c0fb5ddedf707.gif[/img]

[*] Gears
Gears can be acquired during your runs by unlocking chests with ‘Red Gems.’ Most gears offer you a passive perk but we’re also creating active gears that you can use in addition to your skills and weapon attacks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/1ca69ac06a3b000347854ce12480dad2a904f7a0.png[/img]

[*] Cores
As most of you probably already know, Cores are powerful upgrades that grant elemental powers to you and your equipped weapon. We’re adding ‘hyper cores’ which are, as it sounds, hyper-powerful moves that can devastate your foes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/5ccbc9ab02fd767b5f43a0372a730e76b7816942.png[/img]

Using ‘hyper cores’ use up tons of energy but also dishes out tons of damage. Use these cores wisely during combat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38346418/a8d38e7b96317e73a4261781eef36f13f33a369c.gif[/img]

Other than the things we’ve mentioned above, we’re also creating a permanent passive skill system, a tutorial and additional difficulty settings. 
[/list]
[h3]Focus Group Testing[/h3]
We want all these new things to make it to our Early-Access launch. To do so, we need to make sure that we’re on the right track and that these new additions are fun to play! That’s why we need YOU to participate on our focus group test to try out the game in advance. Here’s how you can participate:

notes.title: Regarding user feedback & upcoming news!
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

We’ve recently, for the first time ever, exposed our game to you with our demo build and CBT!
It was exciting for us to finally hear your thoughts on our game.
That being said, we have read each and every one of your feedback and are grateful that you took the time to deliver your feedback to us.

Our team has since had multiple discussions on user feedback and wanted to share with you what will change thanks to your collective voices. 

[h2]Feedback[/h2]

[h3]I don’t know what to do! I’m lost![/h3] 

Our game was designed so that you need to kill a certain minimum number of enemies in the map to activate the teleporter. However, there were many feedback saying that this was not well enough conveyed through gameplay. We are planning to make changes so that users will instantly & intuitively understand how to play and proceed to the next stage via gameplay.

There were also a lot of users that didn’t know ‘Kil’ (the main character) has his own basic move commands such as a ‘dive’ move and a ‘parry’ move. We’re planning to address this by adding a tutorial later on in development.


[h3]Regarding gameplay[/h3]

There were valid criticisms that if you didn’t save enough Red Gems by the time you meet ‘Hank’ you just had to miss out on an opportunity to pay for his awesome upgrades. We completely agree with this feedback and have already made changes so that the upgrades that ‘Hank’ provides are dirt cheap to pay for.

We’ve also came across a bunch of feedback regarding balance issues/concerns. Balance is something that we are always thinking about, and probably something we’ll never be able to get out of our heads. Please continue sending us your thoughts on the overall state of balance in our game, while there is never a “fix-all” solution, we can make better changes with more data & feedback. 


[h3]Bugs...bugs...bugs![/h3]

We are terribly sorry for those of you that weren’t able to play the game for a while due to bugs. While we were able to make relatively quick fixes, we apologize for the inconvenience and loss of your precious time. To be completely honest, this is not something we can promise. But rest assured that QA is never something we take lightly. 




[h2]Crowdfunding on Kickstarter[/h2]

Moving forward: we are planning to make more changes and add more contents into the game for the single goal of making the game more FUN TO PLAY! 

Speaking of us wanting to keep developing, we’ve been planning and waiting for the right time to start our Kickstarter campaign and we’re thinking that it’s going to be REAL soon. 
So if you want to grab an early Steam key for the game & support us during the moment it counts the most to us, we would greatly appreciate it! We’re also planning to have some merch goodies and a chance for some of you to participate in some light designing of in-game contents with us.

Here’s the link to our Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bladeassault/blade-assault


Thank you so much for being part of the pioneering members for Blade Assault. 
We promise to do our part and keep working to make the game awesome for you guys.

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow gamers!

We thought that it was high time for us to write our first notice here on our Steam page to let you guys who are interested in Blade Assault know what we’re up to. We want you to rest assured that we’re hard at work developing Blade Assault. 

[h3][b]<What’s new?>[/b][/h3]
We recently made our announcement with our trailer featured by IGN during Gamescom! Since then, we’ve been getting our very first influx of excited users for our game so we created a Discord server where we can chat about the game together. If you’re interested in the game, please come join us for a chance to try out beta demos and be part of the pioneering community for our game. Here’s the link: https://discord.gg/2TwtHbU


[h3][b]<When will the game be released?>[/b][/h3]
We’re developing the game and hoping to release it on Steam as an Early Access title in Early 2021. This means that we’re looking for an avid community that will give us honest feedback and helpful criticism for what we’re planning for the game. Come join us!


[h3][b]<Any plans?> [/b][/h3]
Good news! We already have enough funding and marketing support to complete the game as is. But we want to run a Kickstarter campaign regardless as we want to get in touch with the vibrant backer community and get as much feedback during our development process as possible from them. Also, the extra funding will allow us to make the game even bigger and better than we originally planned.
Of course, backers will be receiving a copy of the game, other perks and possibly goodies by going the extra mile of backing our game before launch. We’re dedicated to making Blade Assault the best game it can be by spending funding we receive on bulking up our team, adding more supported languages & adding new development stretch goals. If you’re at all interested, please consider following our Kickstarter page to get notifications when it goes live: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bladeassault/blade-assault


[h3][b]<When can I play the game?>[/b][/h3]
We have been planning a demo beta test for dedicated gamers and content creators! For those of you that want to try out the game for the very first time, please go to the link below and fill out our super-short application form for us to reach out to you. https://forms.gle/4UM143mhza1v1iFw9
